scope: Enterprise readiness audit remediation from main; implementation and measured evidence are distinct from production certification

correctnessAndSecurity.deadlineStateMachine: Shared deadline finalizer for advancement/reconciliation; retain running attempts, stop queued work, accept fenced pre-deadline results, classify post-deadline writes UNKNOWN and prevent deadline retries
correctnessAndSecurity.configurationAuthority: All eight service-rule mutation/policy boundaries require service modification plus runbook.manage; UI follows the same capability
correctnessAndSecurity.outputPipeline: Shaped Docker/Kubernetes commands, rejected Secret/ConfigMap capture, shared Agent sanitization before spooling, bounded gzip/UTF-8 validation and sanitization before server storage, separate download capability, download audit, legacy download sanitization and explicit bounded historical rewrite
correctnessAndSecurity.idleClaims: One-second negative-only availability hint with coalesced database probes, no cached authority, existing live claim fences, wait-budget and disconnect handling
correctnessAndSecurity.serviceCount: Independent active-rule count across cursors/search; hidden when not loaded
correctnessAndSecurity.uiAssurance: Rule overview distinguishes configuration, Agent policy, preview and target verification; UNKNOWN details include an investigation checklist

repeatableQualification.functional: Existing version/rule/trigger/approval/cancel/secret/key/pool/outbox suites plus new adversarial authorization, artifacts, deadline races and pagination regressions
repeatableQualification.physicalDockerKind: New disposable executor test and dedicated CI job: Docker stop/start/restart and Kubernetes scale/rollout restart, with independently observed target state and uploaded evidence
repeatableQualification.authenticatedHttp: New signed actual-HTTP 10/100/500/1000-Agent idle workload, two 25-second rounds per size, shared incident-read sentinel, connections, query counts, p50/p95/p99, CPU/memory and artifact bytes
repeatableQualification.faultSafety: Existing lease/spool/start-marker/recovery/cancel/revocation tests retained; deadline race/expiry proof expanded
repeatableQualification.operations: Existing backlog/lease/maintenance alerts retained; v2.1 qualification guide includes observability, data protection, privilege boundaries, upgrade/rollback and operator review

unqualifiedReleaseGates: Native Systemd and Podman physical actions on supported hosts
Physical failure phases before/after claim/start/write/result upload across deployment topologies
Multi-node Agent placement and persistent storage movement, PostgreSQL primary failover, network partitions and full-disk recovery
Sustained authenticated active execution/trigger bursts, concurrent policy changes at the 100-Agent boundary, fairness and shared notification/escalation workloads
Published x64/arm64 release asset fresh install, compatibility, upgrade, rollback and key rotation
Enterprise data-protection approval for historical artifacts, backups and output collection
evidencePolicy: CI artifacts record their actual source revision/topology/limitations. No planned or skipped physical test counts as passing evidence. Never infer production throughput from idle HTTP or direct-library claims.
